blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `updateTaxLinesWorkflow`. It belongs to the `@medusajs/medusa/core-flows` package.

This workflow updates a cart's tax lines that are applied on line items and shipping methods. You can update the line item's quantity, unit price, and more. This workflow is executed
by the [Calculate Taxes Store API Route](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/store/carts/calculate-taxes).

You can use this workflow within your own customizations or custom workflows, allowing you to update a cart's tax lines in your custom flows.

If you use this workflow in another, you must acquire a lock before running it and release the lock after. Learn more in the [Locking Operations in Workflows](https://docs.medusajs.com/learn/fundamentals/workflows/locks#locks-in-nested-workflows) guide.

steps.name: validateCartStep
steps.description:
This step validates a cart to ensure it exists and is not completed.
If not valid, the step throws an error.

:::tip

You can use the [retrieveCartStep](/references/medusa-workflows/steps/retrieveCartStep) to retrieve a cart's details.

:::

steps.name: acquireLockStep
steps.description:
This step acquires a lock for a given key. Learn more about locks in the [Locking Module](https://docs.medusajs.com/resources/infrastructure-modules/locking)
guide.

steps.name: setTaxLineContext
steps.description: This hook is executed after the cart is fetched and before tax lines are calculated. You can consume this hook to add custom context to the tax calculation. The returned object is set as the additional\_context property in the getItemTaxLinesStep input.

steps.name: getItemTaxLinesStep
steps.description:
This step retrieves the tax lines for an order or cart's line items and shipping methods.

:::note

You can retrieve an order, cart, item, shipping method, and address details using [Query](https://docs.medusajs.com/learn/fundamentals/module-links/query),
or [useQueryGraphStep](https://docs.medusajs.com/resources/references/medusa-workflows/steps/useQueryGraphStep).

:::

steps.name: setTaxLinesForItemsStep
steps.description:
This step sets the tax lines of shipping methods and line items in a cart.

:::tip

You can use the [retrieveCartStep](/references/medusa-workflows/steps/retrieveCartStep) to retrieve a cart's details.

:::

steps.name: releaseLockStep
steps.description:
This step releases a lock for a given key. Learn more about locks in the [Locking Module](https://docs.medusajs.com/resources/infrastructure-modules/locking)
guide.

blocks.html:
Hooks allow you to inject custom functionalities into the workflow. You'll receive data from the workflow, as well as additional data sent through an HTTP request.

Learn more about [Hooks](https://docs.medusajs.com/learn/fundamentals/workflows/workflow-hooks) and [Additional Data](https://docs.medusajs.com/learn/fundamentals/api-routes/additional-data).

This hook is executed after the cart is fetched and before tax lines are calculated. You can consume this hook to add custom context to the tax calculation. The returned object is set as the additional\_context property in the getItemTaxLinesStep input.
Handlers consuming this hook accept the following input.

types.name: input
types.description: The input data for the hook.
